displayName: Cost-basis floor blocked a covered call — options-wheel

documentation.content:
The covered-call scan OR the daily roller skipped a held symbol because it had no usable cost-basis floor (FC-065 Phase 1; roll-path events wired in by FC-078, which is FC-066 checklist item 1).

Four events match — the scan pair and the roll pair, same two verdicts on each path. On the ROLL path the stakes are higher: rolling is the one path that places orders without passing execute_call_sale, so this floor is the only thing between a BTC/STO pair and a strike below what the shares cost. A roll-path skip means an ITM short call is riding to expiry unrolled.

- call_scan_skipped_cost_basis_unresolved: Alpaca reported no usable avg_entry_price for the equity position. Since FC-065 that ONE field is the whole floor, and every wheel position is an assigned position, so a recurrence of FC-029's zero-basis behaviour would starve the entire book. Nothing else alerts on it.
- call_scan_skipped_cost_basis_divergent: the broker's avg_entry_price disagreed with the basis reconstructed from BigQuery assignment history by more than max($0.10, 0.1%). The dangerous case is presence with a WRONG value (mis-adjusted split, partial disposal, corporate action), which fail-closed-on-zero cannot catch.

- call_roll_skipped_cost_basis_unresolved / _divergent: the same two verdicts, hit by the daily roller instead of the scan.

Either way the bot is holding shares and writing no calls on them — idle capital, silently, until this is looked at.

Triage:
1. gcloud logging read 'jsonPayload.event_type=~"(call_scan|call_roll)_skipped_cost_basis_(divergent|unresolved)"' --limit=20 --freshness=1d
2. Compare the logged broker_basis / expected_basis against the Alpaca UI position and against options_wheel.trades_from_activities OPASN rows for the symbol.
3. Fail-closed is correct behaviour, not a bug to work around: do NOT lower the floor to unblock writing.

NOTE: the filter deliberately does NOT constrain severity. Cloud Run captures the app's stderr as plain text with EMPTY severity, so a severity>=WARNING clause matches nothing (verified by the FC-030 fire drill 2026-07-18). Payload shape is matched both ways.

Plan: docs/plans/fc-065.md. Runbook: deploy/monitoring/drawdown_pause_alert.md

conditions.displayName: Covered call blocked by the cost-basis floor

conditionMatchedLog.filter: resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name="options-wheel-strategy" AND (jsonPayload.event_type="call_scan_skipped_cost_basis_unresolved" OR jsonPayload.event_type="call_scan_skipped_cost_basis_divergent" OR jsonPayload.event_type="call_roll_skipped_cost_basis_unresolved" OR jsonPayload.event_type="call_roll_skipped_cost_basis_divergent" OR textPayload:"call_scan_skipped_cost_basis_unresolved" OR textPayload:"call_scan_skipped_cost_basis_divergent" OR textPayload:"call_roll_skipped_cost_basis_unresolved" OR textPayload:"call_roll_skipped_cost_basis_divergent")
